chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ibn Abi Umayr from a man from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who marries a woman while she still has a husband, if it is not raised to the Imam, then upon him is to give charity of five sa's of fine flour.
ai.seo_question: What is the financial penalty for a man marrying a married woman in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the *kaffarah* (expiation) for a man who marries a woman while she is still in the *iddah* or marriage of another, specifically when the case is not referred to the Imam for adjudication. The penalty of five *sa's* of fine flour reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on financial restitution as a means of purification in cases of marital irregularity, distinguishing it from judicial divorce proceedings.
